text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years walked alongside 
Mejiro Ryan were a dramatic success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a superstar Umamusume seemed to 
start bringing changes to her daily life 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan, what I wish to discuss with you 
today is the future of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I do believe that the generations to come 
ought to expand the dirt race routes as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
There is no nobility or baseness to a 
racecourse. If the Mejiro family proudly 
declares and enters, the public will 
also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I don't think so, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you opposed to it, Ryan? Do you 
believe dirt is unbefitting of the Mejiro 
family?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, dirt is fine, I just meant there's no 
need to make a declaration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just enter the race normally and get the 
crowd pumped. If you do that, they'll 
follow along.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Silently doing the right thing reaches 
people's hearts far better...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I think... I prefer doing things that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan... you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: How should I put it... it's very Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh, what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am speaking with dignity befitting a 
member of the Mejiro family, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You, who don't care one bit about the 
Mejiro family... are almost more 
'Mejiro-like' in a way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's mean, McQueen! It's not like I 
don't care at all, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm just saying what I felt, it's 
not like it's particularly Mejiro-like..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look, it's Mejiro Ryan-sama. That 
magnificent physique and gait...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a superstar from a 
prestigious house... She is the very 
embodiment of the Mejiro family's pride.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer... What... is this...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As soon as I got results in the Twinkle 
Series, people started making this weird 
fuss over me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's ever told me that I seem like a 
Mejiro, not even once...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All anyone ever talked about was McQueen. 
And yet... seriously...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though I agree...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, maybe I'll start with dumbbell 
presses today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Treat every single rep and set with focus. 
—Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What needs doing hasn't changed. Even so, 
there's a certain class to her actions. 
Could this be..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-What's the matter, Trainer, you 
too!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I'm nothing like a Mejiro! I'm 
not refined at all, just someone who loves 
muscle training.
choice_data_list:
You are now... the representative of the 
Mejiros.

You're already—the one representing the 
Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh... Me, the Mejiro representative...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Me... of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her sheer strength, Mejiro Ryan broke 
through the Mejiro family's traditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From now on, she is the one who creates 
tradition. Her every move will become the 
Mejiro standard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer, are you prepared? You're 
going to meet Grandmother today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You said I was the Mejiro representative, 
but that means you're a Mejiro now too, 
Trainer-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're the one who raised me to 
be who I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together with McQueen 
and Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Now, open the gates—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking Mejiro Ryan's words, "Proper effort 
will be rewarded," and adopting it as a 
new family motto—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The prestigious Mejiro family will 
flourish even further. Alongside the name 
of Mejiro Ryan.
